name.zh: Sollasina 板甲管足棘皮动物

description.en: Original low-poly direction: establish low plated central body surrounded by many long plated tubular podia; emphasize the largest gaps and changes in contour. Simplify fine repeated surfaces; do not copy source geometry.
description.zh: 原创低多边形方向：先搭建低矮板甲主体周围伸出多条细长板甲管足，突出主要间隙和轮廓变化，简化细小重复表面，不复制来源网格。

sources.title: A new ophiocistioid with soft-tissue preservation from the Silurian Herefordshire Lagerstätte
sources.supports: Sollasina plated body and numerous plated podia; fossil supports body-plan reconstruction. Eucladia woodwardi is historical assignment of Sollasina woodwardi.
sources.access_origin: inherited inventory research; not reopened by this planner
sources.rights_note: Consultation is not a license to redistribute source media.

reconstruction_notes.en: Original living whole-organism teaching interpretation: low plated body, organically embedded slender curved tube feet with primary/secondary gaps and restrained articulated surface rhythm. Colors, nominal0.07m span, simplified repeated plates and static pose are art choices. No exact microscopic plate or podium counts, internal water-vascular reconstruction, feeding/movement mechanism or named specimen replica claimed. Blunt flexible-looking tips and curved paths distinguish podia from rigid random spines.
reconstruction_notes.zh: 原创全体教学生活复原：低矮板甲体、自然嵌接的细长弯曲管足、主次间隙与克制的分节表面节奏。颜色、0.07米名义跨度、重复板片简化及静态姿态为美术设定。不主张精确微板或管足数、内部水管系统、摄食/运动机制或具名标本复制。钝柔足端及弯曲走向区别于随机刚刺。

scientific_scope.en: Independently reviewed original stylized-inspired static teaching art. Palette, pose, nominal dimensions and simplified anatomy are artistic choices; not a strict scientific reconstruction or coexistence claim.
scientific_scope.zh: 通过独立审查的原创静态风格化启发教学美术；配色、姿态、名义尺寸及简化解剖属于美术选择，不作严格科学复原或同域共存主张。
